# Shipped egress allowlist for the OpenAI Codex CLI (provider API endpoints
# only — ADR-001 Decision 7; docs/adr/001-task-delegation-privilege-model.md).
#
# Do NOT edit this file to add domains: extensions live in user-owned config
# at ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-~/.config}/second-opinion/allowlist.d/codex.txt (or
# $SECOND_OPINION_ALLOWLIST_DIR/codex.txt) and are surfaced loudly at
# invocation time. Broad entries (github.com, shared CDNs) reopen
# exfiltration paths — keep extensions tight.
#
# One domain per line; `#` starts a comment; `*.example.com` wildcards are
# supported by srt.

# ChatGPT-plan backend used by `codex login` accounts (models, responses
# websocket, MCP gateway). Verified against codex-cli 0.144.6 under srt.
chatgpt.com

# API-key accounts talk to the OpenAI API directly.
api.openai.com

# Login/token refresh.
auth.openai.com
